summary: CORS fix VERIFIED end-to-end via real Chromium/Playwright against production URLs. Duplicated Access-Control-Allow-Origin headers are gone. TEST 2 (reservation customer→admin) PASSES fully end-to-end via UI. TEST 1 (menu CMS→customer) BLOCKED at the CMS UI layer by two pre-existing (non-CORS) UI/backend defects: (a) admin.pizzadenfert.fr/admin panel body renders EMPTY (no open-cms-btn / open-stats-btn / open-reservations-btn visible) even though login succeeds and JWT is stored — those buttons are in the JS bundle but never mount, and (b) admin.pizzadenfert.fr/admin-cms uses Supabase Auth which rejects admin@pizzadenfert.fr/Admin1234! (400 Invalid login credentials). CORS is no longer the blocker; a CMS UI/routing/auth bug is.
final_verdict: STILL BROKEN: CORS is fixed and reservation flow works end-to-end, but the CMS/admin dashboard UI on admin.pizzadenfert.fr/admin renders an empty body (no management shortcuts visible) and /admin-cms uses a separate Supabase-Auth stack whose credentials are unknown — so a menu item cannot be created via any admin UI. TEST 1 cannot complete via UI until either the /admin dashboard body is fixed to actually render its buttons, or Supabase credentials for /admin-cms are provided.

Zero CORS console errors, zero failed requests.

test1_menu_edit_cms_to_customer.root_cause:
Admin CMS UI itself is broken/misrouted. (1) admin.pizzadenfert.fr/admin logs in successfully (POST /api/auth/login 200, @auth_token stored in localStorage) but the AdminScreen ScrollView contentContainer renders as an EMPTY
. The bundle DOES contain testIDs open-cms-btn, open-reservations-btn, open-stats-btn, open-settings-btn, open-staff-btn, open-kiosk-btn, open-ads-btn, open-loyalty-app-btn — all gated by !isLoyaltyApp() which is FALSE-negated (i.e. should evaluate true) on admin.pizzadenfert.fr, but none render. Suggests either (a) an early return in AdminScreen when the fetched user role isn't 'admin'/'owner' (however /api/auth/me returns 200 fine), or (b) an unconditional error higher in the tree that swallows the whole body. (2) /admin-reservations however works fine when navigated directly (see TEST 2). (3) /admin-cms is a totally separate Supabase-Auth screen; POST to https://vgpkxuwcvpkdqgpxnhlu.supabase.co/auth/v1/token returns 400 'Invalid login credentials' with the FastAPI admin creds — this admin CMS is thus inaccessible.

ui_bugs.issue: After successful FastAPI login (auth token stored), the ScrollView body is EMPTY — 0 children in the padded content container. Expected testIDs from the JS bundle (open-cms-btn, open-reservations-btn, open-stats-btn, open-settings-btn, open-staff-btn, open-kiosk-btn, open-ads-btn, open-loyalty-app-btn) never mount. Likely an early return in the AdminScreen render tree gated on a user-role or feature-flag that is falsy for admin@pizzadenfert.fr. Bypass: user MUST know the exact route (e.g. /admin-reservations) and type it in the URL bar. This is a critical CMS regression — the entire admin quick-actions grid is unreachable via UI.

Same as iteration_15: this CMS uses a separate Supabase auth stack (POST https://vgpkxuwcvpkdqgpxnhlu.supabase.co/auth/v1/token 400 'Invalid login credentials' with admin@pizzadenfert.fr/Admin1234!). Menu-management CMS (new-item, new-cat, item-save testIDs exist in the bundle) is therefore inaccessible to the documented admin credentials.

action_items: HIGH: Fix AdminScreen (/admin) empty-body bug. After a successful FastAPI login (auth token in localStorage, /api/auth/me returns 200), the admin-panel ScrollView body renders zero children. Investigate the top-level guard in AdminScreen — likely a role/permission check comparing against a shape that isn't returned by /api/auth/me (e.g. expecting `role === 'owner'` while the API returns `role: 'admin'`), or a Boolean(...) on an async-not-yet-resolved value that stays false. Expected buttons: open-reservations-btn, open-cms-btn, open-stats-btn, open-settings-btn, open-staff-btn, open-kiosk-btn, open-ads-btn, open-loyalty-app-btn.

HIGH: Reconcile the two admin auth stacks. /admin uses FastAPI + JWT (works). /admin-cms uses Supabase Auth (rejects the documented creds). Either: (a) provision admin@pizzadenfert.fr / Admin1234! in Supabase, (b) migrate /admin-cms to FastAPI auth like /admin, or (c) document the working Supabase credentials in /app/memory/test_credentials.md. Right now menu-editing CMS is unreachable via the documented admin account.

critical_code_review_comments: CORS fix is textbook-correct: nginx no longer double-adds ACAO; FastAPI's CORSMiddleware is the single source of truth. Preflight (OPTIONS) still echoes the request origin properly. Real browsers now accept every response.

The empty /admin dashboard is a rendering-guard bug — worth adding a testID='admin-panel-body' and a defensive fallback ('No admin actions available for your role') so future breakage is diagnosable rather than silent.
Having two admin stacks (/admin FastAPI + /admin-cms Supabase) on the same subdomain with disjoint credentials is a governance smell. Pick one.

rca_of_issue: PREVIOUS BUG (iteration_15): duplicated ACAO headers from FastAPI CORSMiddleware + nginx add_header. STATUS: RESOLVED — nginx add_header Access-Control-* removed from api-pizzadenfert vhost, FastAPI CORSMiddleware retained as single source of truth. Verified via curl (exactly 1 ACAO per response) AND via real Chromium browsers (POST /api/auth/login, POST /api/reservations/guest, GET /api/admin/reservations all succeed with no CORS console errors). NEW BUG (iteration_16): admin.pizzadenfert.fr/admin dashboard body renders empty despite successful auth; reproduce by logging in with admin@pizzadenfert.fr/Admin1234! at /account -> staff-access-btn -> admin-login-btn and observing that the ScrollView contentContainer child count is 0. Mitigation: investigate the render-tree guards inside AdminScreen (likely a role/permission mismatch between /api/auth/me response shape and the client's expected shape). Meanwhile, /admin-reservations is directly navigable and works.
